feedback.title: Help improve EzImageAI
feedback.rewardPolicy: Accepted suggestions and bug reports may earn 100–1,000 credits. Our team reviews each submission, chooses the amount and grants credits manually after acceptance.
feedback.noAutomaticReward: Opening this form or sending an email does not award credits. Duplicate or already known reports may not qualify.
feedback.emailPlaceholder: Enter the account to receive credits if accepted
feedback.descriptionPlaceholder: What happened, what did you expect, or what would you improve?
feedback.screenshots: If useful, attach a redacted screenshot in your email app. Remove private information first.
feedback.privacy: Only the text you enter here goes into the draft. No prompt, image, payment details or error metadata is added automatically. Review your email before sending.
feedback.copyFailed: Copy is unavailable. Select the email address above and copy it manually.
feedback.emailFallback: No email app? Copy this address and send your feedback from your usual email service.
